description: Domain enforcement conformance vectors for RandomWalks. Tests that the Markov kernel is valid at entry: neighbor indices in [0,N), weights finite and >= 0, and sampleWeighted requires non-empty input.

preconditions.name: invalid_neighbor_index_rejected
preconditions.description: Neighbor index >= N triggers precondition in walk()

preconditions.name: negative_weight_rejected
preconditions.description: Negative edge weight triggers precondition in walk()

preconditions.name: nan_weight_rejected
preconditions.description: NaN edge weight triggers precondition in walk()

preconditions.name: inf_weight_rejected
preconditions.description: Infinite edge weight triggers precondition in walk()

preconditions.name: empty_neighbor_list_to_sample_weighted_rejected
preconditions.description: Empty neighbor list passed directly to sampleWeighted triggers precondition

valid_inputs.name: valid_symmetric_chain_walk
valid_inputs.description: 4-node chain with positive weights produces a walk of the correct length

valid_inputs.name: all_zero_weights_uniform_fallback
valid_inputs.description: Zero-weight edges trigger uniform sampling fallback; no crash
